chunks.title: Purpose
chunks.heading: Purpose
chunks.text: This document defines the FPPO Goods Movement Automation between the multiple GSTIN of same company, based on the approved process flow.

chunks.title: Business Requirement
chunks.heading: Business Requirement
chunks.text:
The automation covers the end-to-end flow starting from Sales Order creation at one Unit through dispatch, invoicing, receipt at another Unit, and reverse invoicing back to the first Unit.
The remaining processes not linked to material movement will continue to be handled manually.

chunks.title: Scope
chunks.heading: Scope
chunks.text:
The Scope of these specs is to facilitate :
• Automation of inter-unit goods movement transactions

chunks.title: Section 2. Assumptions
chunks.heading: Section 2. Assumptions
chunks.text:
• Sales Order : User created Sales Order at Bangalore Unit.
• Sourcing and Material Requisition
• System shall generate material requisition based on Sales Order.
• Approval workflow: PD → FPPO
• Material Dispatch : User shall create Material Dispatch document post FPPO approval

chunks.title: Changes Required :-
chunks.heading: Changes Required :-
chunks.text:
• Auto Transfer to Site (Material Dispatch)
• Auto Transfer Sales invoice
• Auto Good Received Notes
• Auto Transfer Purchase Invoice

chunks.title: Auto Transfer to Site (Material Dispatch)
chunks.heading: Changes Required :- › Auto Transfer to Site (Material Dispatch)
chunks.text:
Material has to be Dispatched against this FPPO, then
• An Auto-Transfer-to-site GDI will get created from Bangalore to Andhra Pradesh with reference to the above FPPO.
• The E way bill will be created against the dispatch of the materials from Bangalore to Andhra Pradesh.
• The transfer to site GDN created in above section will get displayed in GST Doc integration (As Shown in below screenshot with Transfer to site Dispatch Type) where factory name selected in FPPO will show as a party in E-way bill/E-Invoice.
chunks.locator: § Changes Required :- › Auto Transfer to Site (Material Dispatch)

chunks.title: Auto Transfer Sales invoice
chunks.heading: Changes Required :- › Auto Transfer Sales invoice
chunks.text:
• As soon as above GDN Is confirmed than system will create an auto Transfer Sale invoice against dispatch
• Invoice will be created in the confirmed status.
• Invoice should be available on the GST Doc integration page for the E-invoice generation.
chunks.locator: § Changes Required :- › Auto Transfer Sales invoice

chunks.title: Auto Goods Receipts Note
chunks.heading: Changes Required :- › Auto Goods Receipts Note
chunks.text:
• System will auto create the GRN in the Andhra Pradesh against the above transfer to site from the Bangalore.
• User has to open and confirm the GRN in order to complete receiving of Transfer to site in Andhra Pradesh
chunks.locator: § Changes Required :- › Auto Goods Receipts Note

chunks.title: Auto Transfer Purchase
chunks.heading: Changes Required :- › Auto Transfer Purchase
chunks.text:
• As soon as above GRN Is confirmed than system will create an Auto Transfer Purchase invoice against GRN
• Invoice will be created in the confirmed status.
• Transfer Purchase invoice should be allowed to be posted until corresponding Transfer Sale invoice have been posted
